policy: Do not author disputed claims into a correct answer key. Retain prescribed textbook evidence separately; external fact checks are errata evidence, not replacement curriculum or ALP evidence.

issues.textbookFinding: The paragraph presents repeated testing as a route by which a theory becomes a law or principle.

primaryFactCheck.finding: The NSTA official position distinguishes explanatory theories from descriptive laws and rejects a theory-to-law progression.

issues.draftTreatment: No new question endorses the progression claim. Drafts ask about evidence, continued testing and the named examples of laws.
issues.requiredResolution: Named academic review and any relevant PECTAA clarification; retain the source conflict as visible review evidence.

issues.textbookFinding: The source gives 1878 for Laveran research and places Ross experiments in the 1880s.

primaryFactCheck.finding: CDC scientific-milestones presentation identifies Laveran parasite demonstration in 1880 and Ross mosquito-vector discovery in 1897.

issues.draftTreatment: New malaria prompts do not test disputed historical years or provide treatment instructions; they examine the prescribed hypothesis, prediction and comparison example.
issues.requiredResolution: Named history/academic review and any relevant official errata before date-based question authoring.
